城市“光穹（skyglow）”怎样掩盖星空并影响生态节律？

How does urban 'skyglow' hide the stars and disrupt ecological rhythms?

向上散射的人造光在城市上空形成亮穹，淹没暗弱星光，让城市居民难见银河；同时打乱夜行昆虫、鸟类与植物的光周期，干扰觅食、迁徙与开花。
Upward-scattered light forms a bright dome over cities, drowning faint stars so the Milky Way vanishes; it also disrupts the light cycles of nocturnal insects, birds and plants, disturbing feeding, migration and flowering.

为什么夜里少开一盏朝外的灯，能帮萤火虫和迁徙昆虫？

Why does turning off one outward light at night help fireflies and migrating insects?

人工光会迷惑昆虫的导航与求偶，让它们绕灯乱飞耗尽力气；朝外的灯加装灯罩、调暗、定时关，能留住暗夜，给夜行性动物留一条生路。
Artificial light confuses insects' navigation and mating, exhausting them around lamps; shielding, dimming and timing outward lights preserves dark nights and a path for nocturnal life.

#光污染 #萤火虫 #朝外灯

夜间睡觉时的光（路灯、手机）会扰乱人体什么激素？

What hormone does nighttime light (streetlamp, phone) disrupt while we sleep?

蓝光和夜灯会抑制褪黑素分泌，打乱昼夜节律，让人更难入睡、睡眠变浅。睡前少看屏幕、用暖光小夜灯、拉好遮光帘，能护住睡眠。
Blue light and night lamps suppress melatonin, disturbing the circadian rhythm and making sleep shallower. Less screen time, warm dim nightlights and blackout curtains protect sleep.
